factorization.positive_branch_contract: forall n : Nat, Int.fib (-(n:Int)) = if Even (n:Int) then -Int.fib (n:Int) else Int.fib (n:Int)
factorization.negative_branch_contract: forall n : Nat, Int.fib (-(-(n:Int))) = if Even (-(n:Int)) then -Int.fib (-(n:Int)) else Int.fib (-(n:Int))
factorization.outer_residual: case split every integer as a natural cast or its negation and apply exactly the matching branch contract

reason: The outer residual need not inspect or synthesize the Even decision witness; it only transports two already exact branch equalities through the clean integer case split.
next_on_accept: Construct each exact branch bottom-up from clean fib_natCast, fib_neg_natCast, modulo parity, and Even transport without consulting the official fib_neg proof.
limitations: The residual alone cannot establish either branch or mutate the selected fact.
